001: How did King Dasharatha's prayer bring four princes to Ayodhya? The Ramayana begins here.
002: What made young Rama so loved by everyone in Ayodhya? Watch the four princes grow up.
003: Why did a great sage ask King Dasharatha for his own son? A promise is put to the test.
004: A rakshasi with the strength of a thousand elephants. Would young Rama face her?
005: Sage Vishvamitra gave Rama the shining weapons of the gods. Then Rama asked for one more thing.
006: Six days and six nights without sleep. Could two young princes guard the sacred fire?
007: How did the holy river Ganga come down to earth? Sage Vishvamitra tells the story.
008: Why was an old hermitage near Mithila so silent? Rama's visit changes everything.
009: How does a great king welcome a sage? Rama and Lakshmana arrive in Mithila.
010: No king could even lift it. Then young Rama stepped up to Lord Shiva's mighty bow.
011: A message races to Ayodhya: Rama has broken Lord Shiva's bow! What will King Dasharatha do?
012: One wedding became four! How did two royal families become one big family in Mithila?
013: A fierce storm, a blazing sage and the mighty bow of Lord Vishnu. Could young Rama stay calm?
014: Rama came home a hero. So what did he choose to do next? The answer may surprise you.
